components.html:
Who owns the code?

You do. Code, documentation, and accounts are handed over under your control.

narrative.overview:
Ivory and forest establish an approachable, grounded technology partner. Clay directs action while sage-toned supporting surfaces soften the transitions. Schibsted Grotesk and the flowing CV mark keep the visual voice confident without becoming severe.

The system pairs generous page sections with straightforward controls and ruled lists. Software, consulting, and AI share one visual vocabulary; website care is a separate offer within that vocabulary. Generated software imagery is illustrative, not evidence of client work.

rules.name: Action Color
rules.body: Clay is the primary action color; forest anchors structure and sage supports it.

rules.name: One Family
rules.body: Use the active variable font for headings, body copy, and controls; hierarchy comes from scale and weight.

rules.name: Flat Surfaces
rules.body: Separate regions with tone, spacing, and fine borders rather than decorative shadows.

dos: Do keep controls and inline SVG icons paired with readable labels.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the selected identity consistently across pages.
Do identify generated software artwork as illustrative.
donts: Don't import the other standalone theme's palette, mark, or typography.
Don't imply illustrative artwork depicts a shipped client project.
Don't replace functional labels with decorative microtype.
